home.title: NomNomzBot: run your stream, not your admin work
home.description: An open-source stream bot for Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and X. Moderation, commands, alerts, and overlays in one dashboard. Self-host it for free.
home.comingSoonNote: Sign-in is not open yet. You can self-host your own bot today.

hero.title: Run your stream. Skip the busywork.
hero.subtitle: NomNomzBot moderates chat, answers viewers, and fires alerts the instant they happen. It runs Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and X from one dashboard.
hero.finePrint: Free, self-hosted, open source (AGPL-3.0). No credit card, no seat limits.

features.title: What the dashboard gives you
features.sampleNote: Every preview below uses a made-up sample channel and invented viewers. It shows the real dashboard parts, not a real community.

chat.title: Chat and commands
chat.line: Custom commands, built-in commands, cooldowns, and 90+ template variables in every reply.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.line: Build a reply once as a chain of steps with checks, then reuse it for commands, timers, and events.

check.title: Check: is the viewer a regular?
check.detail: Splits the flow into two lanes

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.line: One review queue for reports and unban requests, plus filters, blocked terms, and spam defense.

loyalty.title: Loyalty
loyalty.line: Channel currency, a store, leaderboards, channel point rewards, giveaways, and chat games.

music.title: Music and TTS
music.line: Spotify and YouTube song requests with a fair queue, and text-to-speech with a voice for each viewer.

tts.title: TTS message from {who}
tts.detail: Approved by a moderator, ready to play

overlays.title: Overlays and widgets
overlays.line: Browser sources for OBS, a widget gallery, and a code editor for your own widgets.

analytics.title: Analytics and recaps
analytics.line: Stream stats, an activity feed you can replay to your widgets, and a recap after the stream.

platforms.title: Multi-platform
platforms.line: One channel, many platform connections, managed from one dashboard.

audience.line: Built for the streamer running the show and the mods keeping the chat clean.

chat.title: Chat gets answered before you can type
chat.body: Build a reply once in the visual pipeline editor. The bot then answers every !command, !songrequest, and !socials on its own, even three at once while you play.

moderation.title: Moderate without babysitting the chat
moderation.body: Reports and unban requests land in one queue, each with the message behind it. You approve, dismiss, or act without scrolling back through chat.

alerts.title: Never miss the moment that matters
alerts.body: A follow, Twitch sub, or raid fires the alert, plays the overlay, and posts the shoutout the instant it happens. You never have to spot it in chat first.

platforms.title: Every platform you stream to, one dashboard
platforms.body: Your commands, mods, and moderation rules work the same on every platform your viewers use. Add a platform without rebuilding anything.
platforms.label: Platforms

deploy.title: Run it your way
deploy.subtitle: Self-host on your own box for free, or wait for the hosted version if you'd rather not run a server.

self.title: Self-host
self.point1: Runs on your server with one Docker Compose command, or as a single binary with no dependencies
self.point2: Every feature, with no seat limits and no paid tiers
self.point3: Open source (AGPL-3.0), so you can audit, fork, and patch it yourself

hosted.title: Hosted by NoMercy Labs
hosted.point1: No server to run: sign in and go live
hosted.point3: Viewers get one free account across every streamer on the instance

deploy.note: Only NoMercy Labs may operate NomNomzBot as a paid service for other streamers. Running your own bot stays free and unrestricted, forever.

integrations.title: Connects to what your stream already runs on

cta.title: Connect a platform. You're live in the dashboard in under a minute.
cta.body: Self-host it for free, forever. It needs nothing from NoMercy's servers.
